subject.title: fix(whatsapp): preserve inbound messages across restarts

question: Should the shared durable-ingress contract gain a persisted FIFO ordering key for equal-`received_at` events, or should the WhatsApp adapter provide a monotonic queue ordering value before enqueueing?
rationale: The current payload-only `receiveOrder` cannot affect core claim order, and changing shared persistent queue ordering is a compatibility-sensitive owner decision.

options.title: Persist FIFO ordering in the shared queue
options.body: Recommended: define and test a durable tie-breaker used by queue claims so every migrated channel receives a reliable same-lane ordering contract.

options.title: Use a WhatsApp-local monotonic enqueue order
options.body: Keep the shared schema unchanged only if the adapter can supply a durable, monotonic value that the existing queue claim order actually respects.

options.title: Accept hash tie-breaking
options.body: Retain the current behavior only if maintainers explicitly accept possible equal-millisecond turn reordering for WhatsApp replay.

recommendation.title: Persist FIFO ordering in the shared queue
recommendation.body: Recommended: define and test a durable tie-breaker used by queue claims so every migrated channel receives a reliable same-lane ordering contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical issue and base commit place this contributor closest to the durable-ingress contract and its intended channel-adapter shape.
